# Input group

An input with addons inside its border: icons, text, buttons.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** A field with a unit or currency, or a search with an icon. Not for separate fields; field lays those out.

- **Use it when:** A search with an icon and a clear button, a value with a unit or currency.
- **Not when:** Controls that are separate fields (lay them out with field).

Instead:

- [Input](./input.md): A plain field.

## Why it works this way

Input group looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Input group, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What icon style?</b><code>iconography.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Outline</div><p>One outline set for every brand.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: A currency sign or a search icon before the text, from the outline set every brand shares.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Empty: icon</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Forms and tasks</div><p>Product pages, sign-up and account forms.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: A currency sign or a search icon before the text, from the outline set every brand shares.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-end</b>: A unit after the value, the same in every brand.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-start</b>: Sign-up and account fields stay one line; field puts the label above, outside the input.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Sign-up and account fields stay one line; field shows the hint and error below.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Alert: default</code> <code>Item: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">4</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 9 answers that follow from it: <b>A moderate amount</b>, <b>Gaps, insets and row heights</b>, <b>Comfortable</b>, and 6 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-naming-lands"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What do components read?</b><code>naming.lands</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Component keys</div><p>Components never change; brand primitives do.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-end</b>: A unit after the value, the same in every brand.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-people-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What accessibility level do we commit to?</b><code>people.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">AA</div><p>AA in every brand.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-start</b>: Sign-up and account fields stay one line; field puts the label above, outside the input.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Sign-up and account fields stay one line; field shows the hint and error below.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: focus</code> <code>Button: disabled</code> <code>Field: vertical</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>AA</b>.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Addon buttons have names; icons that only decorate are hidden from screen readers. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add input-group
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
